title: Aquinas's mystical experience at mass
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Aquinas's mystical experience at mass, about 13th century at unspecified, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: St. Thomas Aquinas was like working on his Summa Theologica this like rational explanation of of God and I think he had this conversion, you know, kind of moment while he was in mass

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Thomas Aquinas, a medieval Christian thinker, was working on his Summa Theologica, a huge book explaining God through reason, when he had a sudden conversion-like experience during mass. Michels tells it as an example of a deeply rational mind being overtaken by a direct mystical experience.
